title: 2009 Prairie's upper front lowered to its photograph
items: The Meyer house at 2009 Prairie: the oriel now stops about half a metre under the string course with brick between, as the photograph shows, and the third-storey window, its hood and carved pendant and the small attic light in the gable all sit 0.2 to 0.8 m lower.

Why: the photograph was taken with the camera turned about 22 degrees to the south, not square to the house. The course that seemed to slope down to the south is level, and the old square reading had placed the north half's upper features too high. The chimney and the north corner's roofline read high too and are next.
